root.name: Zukertort Opening: Regina-Nu Gambit
root.moves: 1. Nf3 d5 2. b3 c5 3. c4 dxc4 4. Nc3

overview: A similar queenside gambit to the Pachman: White plays b3, c4 against ...d5 and ...c5, then after ...dxc4 Nc3 develops with the idea of Bb2 and Nb5 or Ne5. Black can keep the pawn but must develop carefully. Little experience, so I judge by the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Nc3 and Bb2, then regain c4 or Qa4+
Aim at the long diagonal and Nb5

black_ideas.idea: Develop quickly and return the pawn if needed

typical_structures.structure: Queenside gambit with White bishop on b2 and Black pawns c4, c5

character.notes: A gambit with a development edge for White.

sublines_that_differ.name: Nimzo-Larsen main line
sublines_that_differ.how: Parent plays quieter development without the c4 gambit

character.reason: A gambit, though the tactics seem limited.

plans.reason: The b2 bishop and development give compensation.
